content: Streamlit Community Cloud: apps sleep after 12h with no traffic; waking a sleeping app resumes the existing container (not a rebuild) per community reports, but a git push triggers a full redeploy which rebuilds from scratch. Community reports confirm local filesystem writes are lost on reboot/redeploy - local disk is not guaranteed persistent across the app lifecycle. A disk cache mitigates cold-start rate-limit risk within a single running container's lifetime but must not be treated as durable storage across redeploys.
